test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "Nearly."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The use of **"nearly"** in the blank helps provide a more precise and quantitative description of the proportion of respondents who expressed the desire to know if they had Alzheimer's disease.
 
• In this context, **"nearly"** adds the nuance that it's close to, but not necessarily exactly, three-quarters, indicating a high percentage without specifying an exact figure. (इस संदर्भ में, "nearly" यह सूक्ष्मता जोड़ता है कि यह करीब है, लेकिन जरूरी नहीं कि बिल्कुल, तीन-चौथाई, एक सटीक आंकड़ा निर्दिष्ट किए बिना एक उच्च प्रतिशत का संकेत देता है।)
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

You may wonder if anyone would want__ to be diagnosed before they are even aware they have Alzheimer's __disease__? A recent survey shows that, indeed, they would. __**Nearly**__ three-quarters of the respondents said they would want ______ (4) ______ if they had Alzheimer’s disease, even if they were not yet experiencing ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Casually: **in a relaxed and informal way. (अनौपचारिक रूप से; लापरवाही से; अकस्‍मात)
 
• **Firmly: **strongly and tightly. (मजबूती से)
 
• **Totally: **completely. (पूर्णतया, पूरी तरह से)
